title: Smiling Girl Holding Puppy, Garden Shrubs - Vintage 1950s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid snapshot of a young girl standing outdoors on a sunlit lawn, smiling warmly as she holds a small pet or puppy against her chest. She is dressed in a light-colored floral summer dress with short sleeves, posed against a dense backdrop of lush foliage and garden bushes. The back displays album corner mounting marks, a faint Velox paper watermark, and a '51' processing stamp.
